user.title: Add a football team
user.description:
Enter the details of the team you want to track.

To find the **Competitor ID**, go to 365scores.com, search for your team, and copy the number that appears in the URL (e.g. `competitors=1255`).

data_description.competitor_id: Number from the 365scores.com URL. E.g. 1255 for Club América
data_description.team_name: Name you'll see in Home Assistant

error.invalid_id: The ID must be a whole number. E.g. 1255
error.cannot_connect: Could not verify the team on 365Scores. Check the ID and try again.

abort.already_configured: This team is already configured in Home Assistant.

api_unreachable.title: 365Scores: Cannot connect to the API
api_unreachable.description: The integration for {team_name} has failed to fetch data from 365scores.com after several consecutive attempts. Check your internet connection or the status of 365scores.com. This notice will clear automatically once the connection is restored.
